8246.title: Mobile shell duplicates live WebView routes
8246.rootCauseOneLine: Notification responses push non-singular WebView routes; two responses retain three routes, including the original.

prReviews.verdict: Directionally addresses root cause; static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Singular identity and in-page navigation target the verified causes; no PR code was run.

8246.proposedFix: Reuse a single WebView route, separate document identity from destination, and safely navigate a ready same-server page with an older-page load fallback.
8246.caveats: Linux headless reproduction repeated in two clean worktrees. Native process counts, RSS and white-screen timing unverified. Complete reproduction test is inline under report repository policy. Existing open PR #8247 prevents a duplicate fix.
